title.zh: 一次付费终身有效：各大机场不限时永久流量套餐深度横评与避坑清单
title.en: Pay Once, Lifetime Valid: In-Depth Review of Non-Expiring Proxy Packages

cluster.zh: 性价比与永久套餐选购集群

description.zh: 深度解析打破传统“按月清零”规则的不限时永久流量包机制，精算光速云【致敬斯诺克 147】等代表性永久套餐的单 G 成本，并提供防范机房停机与跑路风险的避坑指南。
description.en: Analyzing non-expiring proxy packages that break traditional monthly reset cycles, evaluating unit costs such as Guangsu Cloud Snooker 147 plan and offering risk mitigation strategies.
